claude.sample_unit: adults living with HIV with significant depression symptoms

links.outcome: Effect of Platt recalibration on external-validation calibration and Brier score of the XGBoost model
links.effect: After Platt recalibration, AUC stayed strong (0.940), Brier score improved from 0.174 to 0.113, and calibration slope improved from 7.533 to 1.093.
links.quote: Following Platt-recalibration, XGBoost showed the best overall performance, preserving strong discrimination (AUC 0.940) while improving the Brier score from 0.174 to 0.113 and the calibration slope from 7.533 to 1.093.

unlisted_practices: Adjusting risk prediction for treatment assignment (treatment-adjusted models vs treatment-excluded models)
Decision curve analysis to assess clinical net benefit of a risk model

links.outcome: External validation discrimination and net benefit
links.effect: External validation: XGBoost AUC 0.947 vs Elastic Net 0.924 and Random Forest 0.918; clinical net benefit across relevant thresholds.
links.quote: In external validation, the parsimonious XGBoost model showed the best overall performance (AUC 0.947), compared with Elastic Net (0.924) and Random Forest (0.918), and demonstrated clinical net benefit across relevant decision thresholds.
